# The ZAO

> The ZAO (ZTalent Artist Organization) is a decentralized impact network focused on bringing the profit margin, data, and IP rights back to artists using emerging technology like blockchain and AI. Priority stack: music first, community second, technology third. Founded by Zaal Panthaki (BetterCallZaal).

## What it is

Not a record label or a "music community" - an impact network whose first artist domain is music. It returns three things to artists: profit margin, data, and IP rights. Technology is the means, not the headline. The acronym is ZTalent Artist Organization; what it is today is a decentralized impact network - both are correct.

## Governance - the Fractal and Respect

- Respect is the on-chain contribution currency: a soulbound OG ERC-20 plus a ZOR ERC-1155, both on Optimism.
- A weekly Respect Game ranks contributions; rewards follow a Fibonacci curve. It has run 100+ unbroken weeks (since 2024-07-30).
- On-chain execution via OREC (Optimistic Respect Execution Contract): a 72-hour voting window plus a 72-hour veto window.

## Production lanes

- WaveWarZ - live-traded music battles (Solana mainnet + Base testnet).
- ZABAL Games - the 3-month build-a-thon for artists and builders.
- The ZAO festivals - ZAOstock, ZAOville, ZAO-PALOOZA, ZAO-CHELLA.
- COC Concertz - a recurring metaverse concert series.
- ZAO OS - the lab/monorepo where new ZAO things prototype before they graduate to their own repo and domain.

## How to explore

- thezao.xyz and zaoos.com
- Papers: thezao.xyz/papers (whitepaper, technical whitepaper, manifesto)
- Farcaster: the /zao and /zabal channels
